summary: Diagnosed a full-screen flash on every extension toggle in the Workspace Configure panel, traced it to redundant full store refreshes (refreshProjects ran twice per click, plus a needless detectProject + refreshResources) that churned the shell's projects array. Patched the panel's reapply to only patch setup.config in place, and reworked AgentStore.setProjectGizmoExtension/setProjectPiExtension to apply the server-returned ProjectConfig to just the affected workspace's integrations instead of replacing the whole projects array.
decisions: Store mutators setProjectGizmoExtension and setProjectPiExtension now return ProjectConfig and patch only the affected workspace's integrations/activeDomains in place, instead of triggering a full refreshProjects() that replaces the projects array and re-renders the shell.
WorkspaceConfigurePanel.reapply no longer calls detectProject/refreshResources/refreshProjects; it only patches setup.config from the returned ProjectConfig so only the toggled row re-renders.
Committed the fix as bdf103b 'fix: stop the Configure screen flashing on extension toggles' (initially then amended after a prettier --write).
errors: First edit to WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte failed with 'Could not find the exact text' due to whitespace mismatch; retried after re-reading the file with sed and succeeded.
